request: what was the result of that poll in the thread last week?

expect.awayTo: message history — `tlon messages search` / `tlon messages channel`, answered in one chat reply
expect.why: A lookup about something that already happened. Nothing is created and nothing is kept up to date. It carries the word "poll" on purpose: poll-movie-night is the same word in the opposite direction, and a routing change that only makes the word magnetic will pass one and fail the other.
